results.answer:
Garden Court 排在前面，是因为它更符合您“月租尽量不超过1800新币”的偏好：记录月租1600新币，而 Willow Residence 记录月租1900新币，比这一期望高100新币。

不过，离南洋理工大学更近的是 Willow Residence，直线约850米；Garden Court 约1600米。两套都在5000米范围内，也都满足月租不超过3000新币的必须条件。

所以这次排序是“离学校更近”和“月租尽量不超过1800新币”共同权衡的结果，并非只按离学校远近排；Garden Court 在租金偏好上更合适，因此排在前面。

注意：记录中的价格和当前是否可租，还需要联系确认。

results.answer:
Your requirements:
• Rent no more than S$3,000 per month (must meet).
• Within 5km of Nanyang Technological University by straight-line distance (must meet), and preferably closer.
• Ideally rent at or below S$1,800 per month.

What fits:
• Both homes are within the S$3,000 budget and the 5km limit.
• Garden Court is recorded at S$1,600 per month and 1,600m from the university, so it also meets the preferred rent level.
• Willow Residence is recorded at S$1,900 per month and 850m from the university; it is above the preferred rent level but still within budget.

Why this order: the two preferences are weighed together. Garden Court meets the lower-rent preference but is farther away; Willow Residence is closer but above the preferred rent. The first home comes ahead on the combined result, not because it is closer. Neither home wins on every preference.

Note: recorded prices do not confirm current availability; please check the current rent and whether each home is still available with the agent.
